title: Metrics Runtime v1 — 11-Coordinate Capability Measurement
description: 11-coordinate measurement system for capability runtime costs with budget-flip detection.

coordinates.wall_clock: T — elapsed time per capability invocation
coordinates.update_cost: U — state change cost per learning step
coordinates.retention_rate: R — performance after n time steps
coordinates.plasticity: P — rate of adaptation to new tasks

features: Finite world model (4 capabilities x 3 budget levels)
